description: Australian-built Bristol Beaufort torpedo bomber under long-term restoration, intended to be returned to airworthy condition; the centre's principal project and expected to be ready for full public viewing by the end of 2026. Source: Australian Aviation Heritage Centre Qld collection pages and Moreton Daily, March 2026.

The first Caribou placed into long-term storage at Oakey, 13/05/2009. The centre was the successful tenderer for it in the 2015-16 Australian Government disposal of six Caribou held at Oakey. Identity and current holder confirmed on ADF-Serials.
Ex-Royal Australian Navy Wessex listed on the centre's own collection pages; the individual N7- serial is not published by the centre and was not established. The only helicopter in the collection.

A flying Boomerang is listed among the centre's holdings in the March 2026 Moreton Daily report; the individual A46- serial was not established and the aircraft may be based rather than owned there. Source: Australian Aviation Heritage Centre Qld collection pages and Moreton Daily, March 2026.

Tiger Moth listed among the centre's holdings in the March 2026 Moreton Daily report; registration not established. Source: Australian Aviation Heritage Centre Qld collection pages and Moreton Daily, March 2026.
